section.para: Review how we can gather key information about situations from graphs representing them. Display one graph from the lesson, and ask:

list.item: “How can you use the graph to determine the initial amount?”
“How can you tell whether the growth factor is greater than 1 or less than 1?”
“How can you use the graph to determine the growth factor?”

item.span: “Once you know the initial amount and the growth factor, how can you construct an equation to represent the relationship?”
